scope: Read-only historical analysis. No production edits, new provider runs, historical recovery, or new agents. Natural contrasts only; no randomized causal experiment or new historical deterministic replay performed.

records.mechanism: Mechanical author bindings incorrect; deterministic coverage rejection occurs after independent reviewer accepts. Environment declarations were newly supplied, not all pre-existing facts.
records.observedAction: Operator registers readiness and requests author/reviewer revision with exact AC IDs and references.
records.observedResult: Revised plan and reviewer output retained; ledger ends at next reviewer dispatch. No second plan.decision failure is recorded.
records.supports: Move already-enforced cheap checks before paid review; reduce retyping of existing authoritative fields.
records.doesNotProve: That all intervention was redundant, that latest prompt still fails, or that program assembly raises delivery rate.

records.observedAction: Case stopped; later program-owned revision binding exists in current source.
records.supports: Program should bind authoritative baseline identity, not require error-prone retyping.
records.doesNotProve: Current implementation has the same bug or old ledger should be made compatible.

records.mechanism: Implementation BLOCKED by denied Edit, no changed files; old execution records success with warnings; self-test sends missing implementation to product repair.
records.observedAction: Stale execution recovered; note claims corrected permission mapping; first retry then protocol failure, another retry.
records.observedResult: Later ACCEPT_WITH_NOTES and workflow_completed. No retained target-commit receipt in this case.
records.supports: Separate execution capability recovery from product-code repair.
records.doesNotProve: Exact binary change, automatic retry sufficiency, or target repository delivery.

records.mechanism: Acceptance reaches no must_fix and EVIDENCE_COLLECTION; classified verification insufficiency then self-test incompleteness leads back to implementation.
records.observedAction: Evidence-report step first, then automatic product implementation loop.
records.observedResult: Final implementation fails; no next linked retry in retained ledger.
records.supports: Evidence insufficiency must retain its meaning across subsequent decisions; use existing collection/external-evidence path before code repair.
records.doesNotProve: All review loops wasteful, that extra evidence was available, that all preceding source fixes unnecessary, or that timeout work safe to resume.

records.mechanism: Original final includes prose plus JSON; one syntax correction produces JSON with invalid enum REVISE_PROPOSAL.
records.supports: Classify current error precisely; assess bounded correction by error type.
records.doesNotProve: Jackson bug, correction prompt dropping an enum error not yet produced, or guaranteed success from more retries.

records.mechanism: Bootstrap failure and business-design revisions occur at different transitions.
records.observedAction: Retry note claims restored reviewed acpx environment; later three human design revisions.
records.observedResult: Continued past bootstrap, later revision limit. Final requested repair includes SQLite write ordering and preserved K-line data on failure.
records.supports: Repairing execution removes a local obstruction; real product defects can remain.
records.doesNotProve: Revision cap itself caused failure of already-qualified product; raising cap improves delivery.

records.mechanism: Positive control: similar gates, readiness registration and independent reviews can reach actual delivery.
records.observedAction: Operator adds three real readiness declarations; author/reviewer revision, exact execution approval, implementation and acceptance.
records.observedResult: delivery_committed with commit f8ec3d41cbe1cac554a78c3131372af434440691; earlier independent verification matched Git tree/files and reran 11 unit tests and README doctest.
records.supports: Preserve useful quality review and necessary human declarations; measure actual delivered candidate.
records.doesNotProve: Generic success rate, cheap automation, or broad product correctness from one small task.

records.mechanism: INPUT_INCOMPLETE failures occur at planning, implementation and acceptance, not three identical retries of one node.
records.observedAction: Retry at each boundary, plus an implementation timeout retry.
records.observedResult: Progress after several retries; case snapshot remains RUNNING.
records.supports: Join node identity and causal order before inferring repeated causes or remedy success.
records.doesNotProve: Unchanged-input threefold repetition, retry alone caused progress, or qualified delivery.

prioritize_for_validation: Program-owned mechanical binding and earlier deterministic checks, while preserving missing-readiness gate.
Preserve typed distinction between execution failure, missing evidence, and product defect across full routing.
conditional: Bounded automatic recovery only for a defined safe error subtype with valid authorization and known external state.
not_supported_as_first_fix: Remove independent review or lower quality gates
Claim cachedRead is waste or claim fixed session-scope savings
Add OS write-prevention outside accepted evidence-admission design
